snippet.title: [VIBE IN ACTION K-INITIATIVE] Ep.6 Lab-Grown Organs: Organoids
snippet.description:
Ep.6 Lab-Grown Organs: Organoids (Koo Bon-Kyoung, Director of the Center for Genome Engineering within the Institute for Basic Science(IBS))

The second story in the bio series [Lab-Grown Organs: Organoids]
Organoids are a next-generation biotechnology that uses stem cells to create structures resembling real human organs.
Going beyond simple cell cultures, organoids are drawing attention for their potential applications in drug development, disease research, and personalized treatment.
In this episode, we explore how human organs such as the brain, liver, and heart are being recreated inside laboratories, and examine the future possibilities organoids may bring to medicine.


Ep.6 실험실에서 만드는 장기, 오가노이드 (구본경, 기초과학연구원 유전체교정연구단장)

오가노이드는 단순한 세포 배양을 넘어, 신약 개발과 질병 연구,
맞춤형 치료까지 가능하게 하는 차세대 바이오 기술로 주목받고 있다.

snippet.title: [Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories] How Canadian Forces Defended Gapyeong 75 Years Ago?
snippet.description:
Ep51 How Canadian Forces Defended Gapyeong 75 Years Ago?

On April 24, 2026, a ceremony commemorating the 75th anniversary of the Canadian Forces’ participation in the Battle of Kapyong was held in Gapyeong, Gyeonggido Province.
About 10 months after the outbreak of the Korean War, in April 1951, Chinese forces launched the Fifth Offensive with massive troop deployments in an attempt to recapture Seoul. In response, the British Commonwealth 27th Brigade defended Gapyeong and covered the withdrawal of allied forces. Among them, the 2nd Battalion, Princess Patricia’s Canadian Light Infantry (2PPCLI), was deployed on the rugged Hill 677, where around 700 soldiers fought against an enemy force five times their size. This episode explores the hidden story behind the Battle of Kapyong, one of the Canadian military’s greatest victories during the Korean War.


Ep51 75년 전 캐나다군은 어떻게 가평을 지켰나?

2026년 4월 24일, 경기도 가평군에서 캐나다군의 가평전투 참전 75주년 기념식이 열렸다. 
한국전쟁 발발 약 10개월 후인 1951년 4월, 중공군은 대규모 병력을 투입해 제5차 공세를 개시하며 서울 재점령을 시도했다. 
이에 맞서 영연방 제27여단은 가평을 사수하고 아군의 철수를 엄호했다. 
그 중 캐나다 패트리샤 공주 경보병 연대 제2대대(2PPCLI)는 가장 험준한 677고지에 배치돼 700여 명의 병력으로 5배에 달하는 적군에 맞섰다. 
한국전쟁 당시 캐나다군의 최대 승전 중 하나인 가평전투를 둘러싼 히든 스토리를 알아본다.

snippet.description:
(May 13, 2026) K-Shipbuilding Future Vision Roundtable | K-Shipbuilding, Toward a Greater Future Through Collective Strength

📌0:36 National Ceremony
📌2:21 Opening Remarks by President Lee Jae Myung
📌8:43 K-Shipbuilding Future Vision – Report by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy

📌54:20 Open Discussion

📌1:14:10 Closing Remarks by President Lee Jae Myung

[Representatives from Large, Mid-sized, and Small Shipbuilders, as well as Partner Companies, Participated in Today’s Meeting]

✔ **Countries Connected to the Sea Expect Cooperation with Korea’s Shipbuilding Industry**
▪️Korea’s shipbuilding industry is one of the nation’s flagship industries
▪️A global hub of the shipbuilding industry

✔ **The Korean Economy Has Various Industrial Sectors**
▪️The shipbuilding industry has unique characteristics and is highly exposed to economic cycles
▪️Booms and downturns fluctuate dramatically
▪️Employment issues consistently remain a major concern
▪️Difficult to endure downturns, while labor shortages occur during boom periods
▪️Industrial sites are becoming increasingly layered, leading to instability in employment structures
▪️Related companies and subcontractors are highly exposed to economic fluctuations

✔ **Shipbuilding Is a Highly Important Industry**
▪️Because it is exposed to risks, the role and efforts of the government are crucial
▪️Problems cannot be solved simply by leaving everything entirely to the market
▪️The government must pay close attention to maintaining and developing the shipbuilding ecosystem

✔ **International Competition Is Ecosystem Competition**
▪️Global competition is no longer about individual products, but ecosystems

snippet.title: [The Art of Pairing] Ep.5 A Table that Heals
snippet.description:
Damyang is a place where bamboo forests sway gently in the breeze and life moves at a slower pace. In search of a table that feels both comforting and restorative, Fabri travels to Damyang to discover the flavors rooted in its nature and traditions. At the local market, he encounters some of the region’s signature ingredients, including juksun and tteokgalbi, while meeting the people and stories behind them. His journey then leads him to Chuseong Goeul, a traditional distillery where Chuseongju has been crafted for over a thousand years. There, Fabri experiences the spirit’s deep yet delicate character, shaped by rice, nuruk, and medicinal herbs. Inspired by its gentle complexity, he prepares a table featuring smoky tteokgalbi and crisp juksun muchim. The rich flavors of the meat, the refreshing texture of bamboo shoots, and the subtle aroma of the forest come together in quiet harmony alongside the spirit. How will Fabri bring together Damyang’s nature, tradition, and flavors in one harmonious spread? Join us in Damyang for a healing table that leaves both body and mind feeling lighter.

《《Tteokgalbi recipe》》
① Mix the beef and pork, then add the minced onion and green onion.
② Season with sugar, corn syrup, soy sauce, minced garlic, pear juice, pepper, and glutinous rice flour.
③ Knead the mixture and shape it into bite-sized patties.
④ Slowly grill on both sides over medium heat.
⑤ Reduce the remaining meat juices with Chuseongju, butter, pepper, and soy sauce to make the sauce.
⑥ Slice the pear and cheese, then toss with lemon juice, pepper, and sesame oil to make the garnish.
⑦ Top the tteokgalbi with the sauce and garnish.
⑧ Finish with pine nuts and serve.

《《Juksun muchim recipe》》
① Prep the juksun, onion, cucumber, and ssukgot.
② Make the dressing with gochugaru, gochujang, fish sauce, vinegar, minced garlic, sugar, corn syrup, and sesame oil.
③ Toss the juksun and vegetables in the dressing.
④ Add the ssukgot and lightly toss once more.
⑤ Finish with green onion and sesame seeds.


푸른 대숲과 느린 바람이 머무는 도시, 담양.
쉼 없이 달려온 시간 속에서 파브리는 몸과 마음을 다독여 줄 한 상을 찾아 담양으로 향한다. 시장에서는 죽순과 떡갈비 등 담양을 대표하는 식재료들을 만나고, 그 재료들이 만들어지는 풍경과 사람들의 이야기를 따라간다. 그 발걸음은 자연스럽게 담양의 전통주 양조장, 추성고을로 이어진다. 파브리는 이곳에서 천년의 전통을 이어온 추성주를 만나고, 쌀과 누룩, 약재가 빚어낸 깊고 부드러운 풍미를 경험한다. 추성주와 어울리는 한 상을 위해 떡갈비와 죽순무침을 준비한다. 깊은 풍미의 떡갈비, 아삭한 죽순의 식감, 그리고 대나무의 향을 담은 음식들까지. 과연 그는 담양의 자연과 전통주, 그리고 음식의 균형을 어떻게 한 상에 담아낼까? 먹고 나면 마음까지 편안해지는 담양의 치유 한 상을 만나보자.

《《떡갈비 요리법》》
① 소고기와 돼지고기를 섞고 양파, 대파를 다져 넣는다.
③ 설탕, 물엿, 간장, 다진 마늘, 배즙, 후추, 찹쌀가루를 넣어 양념한다.
④ 반죽을 치대고 먹기 좋은 크기로 빚는다.
⑤ 중간불에서 앞뒤로 천천히 굽는다.
⑥ 남은 육즙에 추성주, 버터, 후추, 간장을 넣고 졸여 소스를 만든다.
⑦ 배와 치즈를 썰어 레몬즙, 후추, 참기름과 함께 버무려 고명을 만든다.
⑧ 떡갈비에 소스와 고명을 올리고 잣으로 마무리한다.

《《죽순무침 요리법》》
① 죽순, 양파, 오이, 쑥갓을 손질한다.
② 고춧가루, 고추장, 참치액, 식초, 다진 마늘, 설탕, 물엿, 참기름을 넣어 양념장을 만든다.
③ 죽순과 채소를 양념장에 버무린다.
④ 쑥갓을 넣어 가볍게 한 번 더 버무린다.
⑤ 대파, 참깨로 마무리한다.

snippet.title: [K-CULTURE MINUTES: K-STORY] Ep.19 Movie 《My Name》
snippet.description:
Ep.19 [K-STORY] Movie 《My Name》

Spring of 1998. Yeong-ok, an 18-year-old boy insecure about having what's been treased to be a girl's name, wins the support of Kyeong-tae, a transfer student from Seoul, and becomes class president. But, he ends up becoming a puppet and becomes part of violence in the classroom. Jeong-soon, a mother who single-handedly raises her son Yeong-ok, pieces together her repressed childhood memories with the help of a new doctor. As she roams all over Jeju wearing sunglasses, memories of the day she had buried for over 50 years begins to surface. The name she wanted to forget out of shame and the name she had to protect with her whole being. The painful secret of Jeju, which was too heavy even to recall, a brilliant truth that pierces through the lives of the two.

1998년의 봄. 여성스러운 이름이 콤플렉스인 18세 소년, ‘영옥’ 서울에서 전학 온 경태의 눈에 들어 반장이 되지만, 꼭두각시로 전락해 교실 안의 폭력을 무기력하게 방관하고 만다. 아들 영옥을 홀로 억척스레 키워낸 어머니, ‘정순’ 새로 온 의사의 도움을 받아 지워져 있던 어린 시절의 기억을 맞춰가는데 선글라스를 끼고 제주의 곳곳을 누빌수록 50년 이상 묻어 두었던 그 날이 수면 위로 떠오르기 시작한다. 부끄러워서 버리고 싶었던 소년의 이름과 온몸을 바쳐 지켜내야만 했던 어머니의 이름. 기억조차 버거웠던 제주의 아픈 비밀이 두 사람의 삶을 관통하는 찬란한 진실이 되어 피어난다.

snippet.description:
(May 10, 2026) Ministry of Foreign Affairs Briefing on the Joint Government Investigation into the HMM Namu-ho Incident

📌4:11 Q&A Session

[Announcement of Investigation Results into the HMM Namu-ho Fire Incident in the Strait of Hormuz on May 4]

✔ **Government Dispatches Investigation Team to the Site**
▪️The government dispatched investigators from the Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal and fire inspection experts from the National Fire Agency
▪️The HMM Namu-ho docked at Dubai Port on the evening of May 7 (local time)
▪️The investigation team conducted detailed inspections of both the exterior and interior of the vessel
▪️The Consulate General of Korea in Dubai, local Korean Register officials, and military experts also participated in the investigation

[Findings Based on the On-Site Investigation]

✔ **Two unidentified aerial objects struck the HMM Namu-ho twice at approximately 15:30 on May 4**
▪️Flames and smoke accompanied by vibrations were observed after the impact
▪️Damage measuring approximately 5 meters wide and 7 meters deep was found on the port-side stern exterior
▪️The internal frame structure was bent inward
▪️Parts of the outer hull protruded and bent outward
▪️CCTV footage captured the aerial objects, though limitations remain in identifying the origin or type
▪️Additional analysis of recovered engine debris from the aerial objects is planned

✔ **Engine Room Fire Presumed to Have Ignited After the First Strike**
▪️The second strike rapidly intensified the fire
▪️The cause of the fire is believed unrelated to the vessel’s internal systems
▪️No abnormalities were found in the ship’s engines, generators, or boilers
▪️The ignition point was identified near a punctured section above the ballast water tank
▪️At the time of the incident, damage occurred approximately 1 to 1.5 meters above sea level
▪️The possibility of attack by a mine or torpedo is considered low due to the nature of the blast pressure
▪️Any additional findings will be disclosed as they are confirmed

snippet.title: [Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories] Korean Tech Hidden Across Tanzania’s Infrastructure?
snippet.description:
With a population of 65 million and a GDP growth rate of 6.4%, Tanzania is drawing attention as a key hub in East Africa. The country established diplomatic relations with S. Korea in 1992, and the Embassy of Tanzania in Seoul opened in 2018. Recent progress in bilateral ties has been driven in part by the participation of Korean companies in infrastructure reforms across Tanzania. KORAIL is overseeing Tanzania’s Central Line railway construction project, while the Tanzanite Bridge—an emerging landmark in Dar es Salaam, the country’s largest city—was built by South Korea’s GS Engineering & Construction. This episode explores the Korean expertise and collaborative effort embedded throughout Tanzania’s infrastructure.


인구 6500만명, GDP 성장률 6.4%, 동아프리카의 허브로 주목받는 나라, 탄자니아다. 한국과는 1992년 수교해 2018년 주한 탄자니아 대사관이 개설됐다. 비교적 최근에 양국 관계가 진전한 데에는 탄자니아의 인프라 개혁이 이뤄지는 곳곳에 한국 기업들이 참여한 덕분이기도 하다. 탄자니아 중앙선 철도 건설 사업에 코레일이 감리를 맡고 있으며, 최대 도시 다르에스살람의 떠오르는 명소인 탄자나이트 교량은 GS 건설이 공사했다. 탄자니아 인프라 곳곳에 숨겨진 한국의 땀과 기술을 알아본다.

snippet.title: [The Art of Pairing] Ep.4 One Table, All Together
snippet.description:
Ep.4 One Table, All Together

In Andong, where time moves at its own quiet pace, Tradition lives on as part of everyday life. Here, Fabri begins another journey, guided by the flavors of the region and its time-honored spirits. At the market, he encounters ingredients that define Andong, and before long, his steps lead him to where a single drink holds generations of craft. At Menge Craft Distillery, he discovers Jinmaek Soju, a spirit known for its deep and intense character, and experiences the time and dedication behind it. Bold yet clean on the finish, it reveals an even sharper balance when paired with food. Inspired by Andong’s local ingredients and traditional liquor, Fabri prepares dakgalbi and grilled gan godeungeo, bringing fire, depth, and balance to one harmonious spread. How will he bring together the smokiness of the flame, the richness of the fish, and the bold identity of traditional soju into one perfect pairing? 
Now, join us, at a table where time and flavor come together.

Dakgalbi
① Prep the chicken thighs and marinate it with the sauce.
② Cut the vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
③ Stir-fry the chicken first over medium heat to release its juices.
④ Add the vegetables in order and stir-fry together.
⑤ inish with tteok.

Gan Godeungeo Gui & Sesame Oil Mayo Sauce
① Place the mackerel on a lined pan and grill skin-side first.
② Flip and cook briefly to finish.
③ Make the mayo with egg, lemon juice, soy sauce, and neutral oil.
④ Add sesame oil, garlic, lemon zest, and chili for extra depth.
⑤ Serve alongside the grilled mackerel.


Ep.4 어우러짐의 한 상

시간이 천천히 흐르는 도시, 안동.
전통이 일상처럼 이어지는 이곳에서 파브리는 지역의 맛과 술을 따라 또 한 번의 여정을 시작한다. 시장에서는 안동을 대표하는 식재료들을 만나고, 그 발걸음은 자연스럽게 한 잔의 술이 만들어지는 곳으로 향한다. 맹개술도에서 그는 깊고 강렬한 풍미를 지닌 진맥소주를 만나고, 그 안에 담긴 시간과 정성을 경험한다. 묵직하지만 깔끔하게 떨어지는 맛, 그리고 음식과 만났을 때 더욱 선명해지는 균형. 
파브리는 안동의 식재료와 전통주를 바탕으로 닭갈비와 간고등어 구이를 준비하며 한 상의 조화를 완성해 나간다. 과연 그는 불맛의 깊이와 생선의 담백함, 그리고 전통주의 개성을 어떻게 하나로 풀어낼까? 지금, 시간과 맛이 이어지는 한 상을 만나보자.

《닭갈비 레시피》
① 닭다리살을 손질해 양념에 버무리고 잠시 재운다.
② 채소를 먹기 좋게 손질한다.
③ 팬에 닭고기를 먼저 볶아 육즙을 낸다.
④ 채소를 순서대로 넣어 함께 볶는다.
⑤ 떡을 넣어 마무리한다.

간고등어 구이 & 참기름 마요네즈 소스
① 팬에 종이호일을 깔고 중불에서 고등어를 껍질부터 굽는다.
② 뒤집어 잠시 더 익혀 마무리한다.
③ 달걀, 레몬즙, 간장, 식용유로 마요네즈를 만든다.
④ 참기름, 마늘, 레몬 제스트, 고추를 더해 풍미를 살린다.
⑤ 구운 고등어와 함께 곁들여 완성한다.

snippet.title: [SMARTBIZ ACCELERATORS] Keeping the tradition of Korean kimchi, kimjangdok (김장독)
snippet.description:
Keeping the tradition of Korean kimchi, kimjangdok
Kimchi is a traditional Korean side dish and it can be made with different ingredients. By using napa cabbages with a natural sweet taste, kimjangdok has developed kimchi with reduced saltiness and an improved flavor of red pepper powder. The low-salt soaking process is carried out for 24 hours. And the firm has focused effort into keeping the optimal salinity level. The company has mainly produced Jeollanam-do-style kimchi which has a spicy, but a deep and savory taste. Napa cabbage kimchi, young radish kimchi and green onion kimchi are the main products. And all the products are made with low-sodium salted seafood. The napa cabbages go through the soaking process for a longer period of time. Also, the mixed seasoning is spread between every leaf of the cabbage. We explore kimjangdok, which has put top priority on improving the systematic production system. 

For more information: msh3777@hanmail.net


김장독에서 천천히 익어가던 김치의 맛을 재현하는 김장독
한국을 대표하는 음식이자 다양한 맛과 종류를 자랑하는 김치. 김장독은 짠맛을 줄이고 배추의 자연스러운 단맛과 고춧가루의 풍미를 살린 김치를 만드는 기업이다. 24시간 저염 절임 과정을 통해 김치의 염도를 고르게 맞추는 데 집중해 매콤하면서도 짠맛은 덜한 전라남도식 김치를 선보인다. 대표제품으로는 포기김치부터 열무김치, 파김치, 갓김치 등이 있으며 모든 제품은 저염 젓갈로 만들어진다. 저염 김치를 만드는 기업답게 생산공정 중 절임 공정에서 일반적인 절임 시간보다 더 긴 시간 배추를 절이며 적절한 비율로 배합된 양념을 배춧잎 사이사이에 꼼꼼히 버무리는 작업을 거친다. 맛있는 김치는 체계적인 생산공정으로 시작된다는 원칙을 이어가는 김장독을 만나본다.

snippet.title: [VIBE IN ACTION K-INITIATIVE] Ep.6 Lab-Grown Organs: Organoids
snippet.description:
Ep.6 Lab-Grown Organs: Organoids (Koo Bon-Kyoung, Director of the Center for Genome Engineering within the Institute for Basic Science(IBS))

The second story in the bio series [Lab-Grown Organs: Organoids]
Organoids are a next-generation biotechnology that uses stem cells to create structures resembling real human organs.
Going beyond simple cell cultures, organoids are drawing attention for their potential applications in drug development, disease research, and personalized treatment.
In this episode, we explore how human organs such as the brain, liver, and heart are being recreated inside laboratories, and examine the future possibilities organoids may bring to medicine.


Ep.6 실험실에서 만드는 장기, 오가노이드 (구본경, 기초과학연구원 유전체교정연구단장)

줄기세포를 배양해 실제 장기와 유사한 구조를 만들어내는 기술, ‘오가노이드’.

snippet.title: (MAY 15, 2026) BLUE HOUSE BRIEFING
snippet.description:
(May 15, 2026) Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Lee Kyu-yeon’s Briefing on Government Personnel Appointments

📌4:01 Q&A Session

[Government Personnel Appointments Briefing]

✔ **Hyun Soo-yeop Appointed 1st Vice Minister of Health and Welfare**
▪️Previously served as Director General for Population and Child Policy and Head of Childcare Policy Division
▪️A career official who has held major positions within the Ministry of Health and Welfare
▪️As a working mother, contributed to improving treatment and conditions for childcare teachers

✔ **Lee Jong-wook Appointed Commissioner of the Korea Customs Service**
▪️A career official who has held key positions within the Korea Customs Service
▪️Detected large-scale illegal transshipment exports
▪️Has experience conducting joint narcotics crackdowns with the Thai government

✔ **Moon Seong-yo Appointed Commissioner of the Saemangeum Development and Investment Agency**
▪️Former Director General for Planning and Coordination at the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport
▪️Expected to help transform Saemangeum into a hub for future advanced industries

✔ **Former Lawmaker Hong Mi-young Appointed Chairperson of the National Commission on Sustainable Development**
▪️Expert with 30 years of experience in women’s welfare and decentralization policy
▪️Considered well-suited to contribute to sustainable development policies for the public

✔ **Professor Baek Jong-woo of Kyung Hee University Appointed Vice Chairperson of the National Commission on Life and Safety**
▪️Former Director of the Korea Suicide Prevention Center
▪️Mental health expert who has worked extensively in trauma recovery
▪️Considered well-suited to building a prevention-oriented safe society

✔ **Professor Kim Ki-young of Yonsei University Appointed Chairperson of the National Library Commission**
▪️Scholar in library and information science specializing in public library policy and reading education
▪️Expertise in data-based research and analysis
▪️Expected to contribute to narrowing knowledge and information gaps

#Briefing #BlueHouse #SeniorSecretaryForPublicRelationsAndCommunication

🔹Date: May 15, 2026 (Fri) 14:00
🔹Venue: Main Briefing Room, Chunchugwan, Blue House
🔹Speaker: Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Lee Kyu-yeon

snippet.title: (MAY 14, 2026) THE 33RD PRESIDENTIAL SENIOR SECRETARIES' MEETING
snippet.description:
(MAY 14, 2026) THE 33RD PRESIDENTIAL SENIOR AIDES' MEETING

📌4:39 Start of Meeting

[Agriculture Is a Core Strategic Industry Responsible for Food Sovereignty and the Survival of the Nation]

✔ **The Sacrifice and Dedication of Rural Communities Fueled Korea’s Industrialization and Economic Leap**
▪️Today, many rural communities face extinction due to aging populations, climate crises, and the outflow of young people
▪️Now is the time to actively pursue a major transformation of rural areas and agriculture
▪️All available policies and measures must be mobilized to substantially improve farmers’ quality of life
▪️Policies proven effective, such as basic income for rural and fishing communities and solar energy income programs, should be expanded

✔ **Accelerating Rural Transformation to Improve Farmers’ Quality of Life**
▪️Expand policy financing support and continue efforts to rapidly spread smart farming
▪️Speed up reforms in agricultural distribution systems as well
▪️The government must concentrate its capabilities on agricultural transformation and shared growth
▪️Transformation of rural communities and agriculture must begin with correcting structural problems

✔ **Normalization of the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation Is Crucial**
▪️The National Agricultural Cooperative Federation carries significant responsibilities
▪️Normalization measures must be completed without disruption
▪️Called for faster progress in institutional reforms such as direct elections by cooperative members

[Tragic Incident in Gwangju Resulted in the Death of a Teenager Due to a Violent Crime]

✔ **Condolences and Calls for Stronger Protection Measures**
▪️Extended condolences to the deceased student and sympathy to the bereaved family
▪️Also wished for the speedy recovery of the other injured student
▪️Called for stronger crime prevention and response systems for socially vulnerable groups
▪️Ordered thorough special security activities in areas vulnerable to crime
▪️Urged all public officials to do their utmost to protect public safety with a heightened sense of responsibility

#PresidentLeeJaeMyung #SeniorAdvisorsMeeting #OpeningRemarks

🔹Date: May 14, 2026 (Thu) 17:00
🔹Venue: Yeomin Hall, Blue House

▪️Now is the time to actively pursue a major transformation of rural areas and agriculture

▪️Expand policy financing support and continue efforts to rapidly spread smart farming

▪️The government must concentrate its capabilities on agricultural transformation and shared growth
▪️Transformation of rural communities and agriculture must begin with correcting structural problems

▪️The National Agricultural Cooperative Federation carries significant responsibilities
▪️Normalization measures must be completed without disruption
▪️Called for faster progress in institutional reforms such as direct elections by cooperative members

▪️Extended condolences to the deceased student and sympathy to the bereaved family

▪️Called for stronger crime prevention and response systems for socially vulnerable groups

snippet.title: [K-CULTURE MINUTES: K-PEOPLE] Ep.19 Haegeum Player Shin Nal-sae
snippet.description:
Ep.19 [K-PEOPLE] Haegeum Player Shin Nal-sae

The haegeum player Shin Nal-sae, who won the BrandLaureate International Brand Leadership Award 2025-2026.
The BrandLaureate Awards are prestigious global brand awards given to legendary figures in various fields, including Ben Bernanke, Hillary Clinton, Bill Gates, Steve Jobs, Sean Connery, Tom Cruise, and Adele.
This episode explores the musical philosophy and world of Shin, who is both a composer and a haegeum performer.


Ep.19 [K-PEOPLE] 해금 연주자 신날새

2025~2026 브랜드로레이 아이콘 리더십상을 수상한 해금 연주자 신날새.
브랜드로레이 어워드는 벤 버냉키, 힐러리 클린턴, 빌 게이츠, 스티브 잡스, 숀 코너리, 톰 크루즈, 아델 등 각 분야의 레전드급 인물들에게 수여되는 세계적으로 권위있는 브랜드 상이다.
작곡가이자 해금 연주자인 신날새의 음악철학과 음악세계를 탐험한다.

snippet.title: [Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories] How Canadian Forces Defended Gapyeong 75 Years Ago?
snippet.description:
Ep51 How Canadian Forces Defended Gapyeong 75 Years Ago?

On April 24, 2026, a ceremony commemorating the 75th anniversary of the Canadian Forces’ participation in the Battle of Kapyong was held in Gapyeong, Gyeonggido Province.
About 10 months after the outbreak of the Korean War, in April 1951, Chinese forces launched the Fifth Offensive with massive troop deployments in an attempt to recapture Seoul. In response, the British Commonwealth 27th Brigade defended Gapyeong and covered the withdrawal of allied forces. Among them, the 2nd Battalion, Princess Patricia’s Canadian Light Infantry (2PPCLI), was deployed on the rugged Hill 677, where around 700 soldiers fought against an enemy force five times their size. This episode explores the hidden story behind the Battle of Kapyong, one of the Canadian military’s greatest victories during the Korean War.


Ep51 75년 전 캐나다군은 어떻게 가평을 지켰나?

2026년 4월 24일, 경기도 가평군에서 캐나다군의 가평전투 참전 75주년 기념식이 열렸다. 
한국전쟁 발발 약 10개월 후인 1951년 4월, 중공군은 대규모 병력을 투입해 제5차 공세를 개시하며 서울 재점령을 시도했다. 
이에 맞서 영연방 제27여단은 가평을 사수하고 아군의 철수를 엄호했다. 
그 중 캐나다 패트리샤 공주 경보병 연대 제2대대(2PPCLI)는 가장 험준한 677고지에 배치돼 700여 명의 병력으로 5배에 달하는 적군에 맞섰다. 
한국전쟁 당시 캐나다군의 최대 승전 중 하나인 가평전투를 둘러싼 히든 스토리를 알아본다.

On April 24, 2026, a ceremony commemorating the 75th anniversary of the Canadian Forces’ participation in the Battle of Kapyong was held in Gapyeong, Gyeonggido Province.
About 10 months after the outbreak of the Korean War, in April 1951, Chinese forces launched the Fifth Offensive with massive troop deployments in an attempt to recapture Seoul. In response, the British Commonwealth 27th Brigade defended Gapyeong and covered the withdrawal of allied forces. Among them, the 2nd Battalion, Princess Patricia’s Canadian Light Infantry (2PPCLI), was deployed on the rugged Hill 677, where around 700 soldiers fought against an enemy force five times their size. This episode explores the hidden story behind the Battle of Kapyong, one of the Canadian military’s greatest victories during the Korean War.


Ep51 75년 전 캐나다군은 어떻게 가평을 지켰나?

2026년 4월 24일, 경기도 가평군에서 캐나다군의 가평전투 참전 75주년 기념식이 열렸다. 
한국전쟁 발발 약 10개월 후인 1951년 4월, 중공군은 대규모 병력을 투입해 제5차 공세를 개시하며 서울 재점령을 시도했다. 
이에 맞서 영연방 제27여단은 가평을 사수하고 아군의 철수를 엄호했다. 
그 중 캐나다 패트리샤 공주 경보병 연대 제2대대(2PPCLI)는 가장 험준한 677고지에 배치돼 700여 명의 병력으로 5배에 달하는 적군에 맞섰다. 
한국전쟁 당시 캐나다군의 최대 승전 중 하나인 가평전투를 둘러싼 히든 스토리를 알아본다.

snippet.title: (MAY 13, 2026) K-SHIPBUILDING FUTURE VISION ROUNDTABLE
snippet.description:
(May 13, 2026) K-Shipbuilding Future Vision Roundtable | K-Shipbuilding, Toward a Greater Future Through Collective Strength

📌0:36 National Ceremony
📌2:21 Opening Remarks by President Lee Jae Myung
📌8:43 K-Shipbuilding Future Vision – Report by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy

📌17:21 Discussion) Major Shipbuilders
📌23:50 Discussion) Mid-sized Shipbuilders
📌31:55 Discussion) Small Shipyards
📌37:55 Discussion) Ship Equipment Industry
📌43:56 Discussion) Partner Companies
📌49:42 Discussion) Labor Representatives
📌54:20 Open Discussion

📌1:14:10 Closing Remarks by President Lee Jae Myung

[Representatives from Large, Mid-sized, and Small Shipbuilders, as well as Partner Companies, Participated in Today’s Meeting]

✔ **Countries Connected to the Sea Expect Cooperation with Korea’s Shipbuilding Industry**
▪️Korea’s shipbuilding industry is one of the nation’s flagship industries
▪️A global hub of the shipbuilding industry

✔ **The Korean Economy Has Various Industrial Sectors**
▪️The shipbuilding industry has unique characteristics and is highly exposed to economic cycles
▪️Booms and downturns fluctuate dramatically
▪️Employment issues consistently remain a major concern
▪️Difficult to endure downturns, while labor shortages occur during boom periods
▪️Industrial sites are becoming increasingly layered, leading to instability in employment structures
▪️Related companies and subcontractors are highly exposed to economic fluctuations

✔ **Shipbuilding Is a Highly Important Industry**
▪️Because it is exposed to risks, the role and efforts of the government are crucial
▪️Problems cannot be solved simply by leaving everything entirely to the market
▪️The government must pay close attention to maintaining and developing the shipbuilding ecosystem

✔ **International Competition Is Ecosystem Competition**
▪️Global competition is no longer about individual products, but ecosystems
▪️A well-established ecosystem creates international competitiveness
▪️Relying solely on specific companies without an ecosystem makes it difficult to withstand crises

✔ **Global Interest in the Shipbuilding Industry Is Growing**
▪️Shipbuilding has been selected as a key sector in major U.S. investment projects
▪️It is one of the most important areas of Korea–U.S. investment cooperation
▪️The industry holds significant future potential and opportunities
▪️It is important to create a system where both employers and workers can benefit together
▪️The government will continue considering what more it can do to support the industry

#KShipbuilding #FutureVisionRoundtable #PresidentLeeJaeMyung

🔹Date: May 13, 2026 (Wed) 15:50
🔹Venue: Diamond Hall, Lahan Hotel Ulsan

snippet.title: [K-CULTURE MINUTES: K-STAGE] Ep.19 Original Ballet 《Ahn Jung-geun, a Dance in Heaven》
snippet.description:
Ep.19 [K-STAGE] Original Ballet 《Ahn Jung-geun, a Dance in Heaven》

The ballet commemorates the 116th anniversary of independence fighter Ahn Jung-geun's death. 
It begins with Ahn Jung-geun's death sentence in Lushun Prison and shows his reflections on his family and homeland, through his leadership of the Korean Independence Army based in the Russian Far East, the victories and defeats in battle, his guilt, his finger-severing alliance, and the preparations for the assassination attempt in Harbin.


Ep.19 [K-STAGE] 발레 《안중근, 천국에서의 춤》

안중근 의사 순국 116주기를 맞아 안중근 의사의 애국과 평화의 정신을 표현한  창작 발레다. 뤼순감옥에서 사형을 선고받은 안중근이 가족과 조국을 떠올리는 장면에서 출발해 연해주 의병활동, 전투의 승패와 죄책감, 단지동맹, 하얼빈 의거 준비로 이어지는 흐름을 발레 몸짓으로 밀도 있게 그려낸다

snippet.title: (MAY 13, 2026) BLUE HOUSE BRIEFING
snippet.description:
(May 13, 2026) Press Briefing by Senior Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung on Meetings with Scott Bessent and He Lifeng

📌5:58 Q&A Session

[President Lee Jae Myung Meets U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent]

✔ **President Lee: Korea and the U.S. Demonstrate Stable Economic Conditions**
▪️President Lee emphasized the need for closer communication and stronger economic cooperation between the two countries

✔ **Need to Further Advance Bilateral Cooperation in Economy and Technology**
▪️Highlighted the importance of cooperation in supply chains, including critical minerals, and in foreign exchange markets
▪️Secretary Bessent expressed agreement with President Lee’s views on Korea–U.S. cooperation
▪️Secretary Bessent noted Korea’s remarkable achievements in growth and stock market performance despite challenges such as the Middle East conflict

✔ **President Lee Calls for Mutually Beneficial Strategic Investment**
▪️Requested efforts to ensure Korea–U.S. strategic investments benefit both countries
▪️Expressed Korea’s willingness to actively cooperate on key agendas of the U.S. as G20 chair
▪️Highlighted the need for close Korea–U.S. cooperation as Korea prepares to assume the G20 presidency in 2028
▪️Secretary Bessent described Korea as a key partner in the international community, including within the G20

[President Lee Meets Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng]

✔ **President Lee: Development of U.S.–China Relations Benefits Global Prosperity**
▪️Stated that the Korean government will do its utmost to support smooth negotiations between the two countries

✔ **Restoration of Korea–China Relations and Practical Diplomacy**
▪️Emphasized expanding cooperation in ways that contribute to the livelihoods of both peoples in line with changing times
▪️Called for continued close communication to achieve practical outcomes in economy, industry, and trade
▪️Requested Vice Premier He to play an active role

✔ **Vice Premier He Lifeng: Pleased with Positive Momentum in Korea–China Relations**
▪️Expressed commitment to faithfully implementing agreements reached by the leaders of both countries

snippet.title: [The Art of Pairing] Ep.5 A Table that Heals
snippet.description:
Damyang is a place where bamboo forests sway gently in the breeze and life moves at a slower pace. In search of a table that feels both comforting and restorative, Fabri travels to Damyang to discover the flavors rooted in its nature and traditions. At the local market, he encounters some of the region’s signature ingredients, including juksun and tteokgalbi, while meeting the people and stories behind them. His journey then leads him to Chuseong Goeul, a traditional distillery where Chuseongju has been crafted for over a thousand years. There, Fabri experiences the spirit’s deep yet delicate character, shaped by rice, nuruk, and medicinal herbs. Inspired by its gentle complexity, he prepares a table featuring smoky tteokgalbi and crisp juksun muchim. The rich flavors of the meat, the refreshing texture of bamboo shoots, and the subtle aroma of the forest come together in quiet harmony alongside the spirit. How will Fabri bring together Damyang’s nature, tradition, and flavors in one harmonious spread? Join us in Damyang for a healing table that leaves both body and mind feeling lighter.

《《Tteokgalbi recipe》》
① Mix the beef and pork, then add the minced onion and green onion.
② Season with sugar, corn syrup, soy sauce, minced garlic, pear juice, pepper, and glutinous rice flour.
③ Knead the mixture and shape it into bite-sized patties.
④ Slowly grill on both sides over medium heat.
⑤ Reduce the remaining meat juices with Chuseongju, butter, pepper, and soy sauce to make the sauce.
⑥ Slice the pear and cheese, then toss with lemon juice, pepper, and sesame oil to make the garnish.
⑦ Top the tteokgalbi with the sauce and garnish.
⑧ Finish with pine nuts and serve.

《《Juksun muchim recipe》》
① Prep the juksun, onion, cucumber, and ssukgot.
② Make the dressing with gochugaru, gochujang, fish sauce, vinegar, minced garlic, sugar, corn syrup, and sesame oil.
③ Toss the juksun and vegetables in the dressing.
④ Add the ssukgot and lightly toss once more.
⑤ Finish with green onion and sesame seeds.


푸른 대숲과 느린 바람이 머무는 도시, 담양.
쉼 없이 달려온 시간 속에서 파브리는 몸과 마음을 다독여 줄 한 상을 찾아 담양으로 향한다. 시장에서는 죽순과 떡갈비 등 담양을 대표하는 식재료들을 만나고, 그 재료들이 만들어지는 풍경과 사람들의 이야기를 따라간다. 그 발걸음은 자연스럽게 담양의 전통주 양조장, 추성고을로 이어진다. 파브리는 이곳에서 천년의 전통을 이어온 추성주를 만나고, 쌀과 누룩, 약재가 빚어낸 깊고 부드러운 풍미를 경험한다. 추성주와 어울리는 한 상을 위해 떡갈비와 죽순무침을 준비한다. 깊은 풍미의 떡갈비, 아삭한 죽순의 식감, 그리고 대나무의 향을 담은 음식들까지. 과연 그는 담양의 자연과 전통주, 그리고 음식의 균형을 어떻게 한 상에 담아낼까? 먹고 나면 마음까지 편안해지는 담양의 치유 한 상을 만나보자.

《《떡갈비 요리법》》
① 소고기와 돼지고기를 섞고 양파, 대파를 다져 넣는다.
③ 설탕, 물엿, 간장, 다진 마늘, 배즙, 후추, 찹쌀가루를 넣어 양념한다.
④ 반죽을 치대고 먹기 좋은 크기로 빚는다.
⑤ 중간불에서 앞뒤로 천천히 굽는다.
⑥ 남은 육즙에 추성주, 버터, 후추, 간장을 넣고 졸여 소스를 만든다.
⑦ 배와 치즈를 썰어 레몬즙, 후추, 참기름과 함께 버무려 고명을 만든다.
⑧ 떡갈비에 소스와 고명을 올리고 잣으로 마무리한다.

《《죽순무침 요리법》》
① 죽순, 양파, 오이, 쑥갓을 손질한다.
② 고춧가루, 고추장, 참치액, 식초, 다진 마늘, 설탕, 물엿, 참기름을 넣어 양념장을 만든다.
③ 죽순과 채소를 양념장에 버무린다.
④ 쑥갓을 넣어 가볍게 한 번 더 버무린다.
⑤ 대파, 참깨로 마무리한다.

snippet.title: [K-CULTURE MINUTES: K-STORY] Ep.19 Movie 《My Name》
snippet.description:
Ep.19 [K-STORY] Movie 《My Name》

Spring of 1998. Yeong-ok, an 18-year-old boy insecure about having what's been treased to be a girl's name, wins the support of Kyeong-tae, a transfer student from Seoul, and becomes class president. But, he ends up becoming a puppet and becomes part of violence in the classroom. Jeong-soon, a mother who single-handedly raises her son Yeong-ok, pieces together her repressed childhood memories with the help of a new doctor. As she roams all over Jeju wearing sunglasses, memories of the day she had buried for over 50 years begins to surface. The name she wanted to forget out of shame and the name she had to protect with her whole being. The painful secret of Jeju, which was too heavy even to recall, a brilliant truth that pierces through the lives of the two.

*This video is approved by the distributor and the content provided via legitimate channels


Ep.19 [K-STORY] 영화 《내 이름은》

1998년의 봄. 여성스러운 이름이 콤플렉스인 18세 소년, ‘영옥’ 서울에서 전학 온 경태의 눈에 들어 반장이 되지만, 꼭두각시로 전락해 교실 안의 폭력을 무기력하게 방관하고 만다. 아들 영옥을 홀로 억척스레 키워낸 어머니, ‘정순’ 새로 온 의사의 도움을 받아 지워져 있던 어린 시절의 기억을 맞춰가는데 선글라스를 끼고 제주의 곳곳을 누빌수록 50년 이상 묻어 두었던 그 날이 수면 위로 떠오르기 시작한다. 부끄러워서 버리고 싶었던 소년의 이름과 온몸을 바쳐 지켜내야만 했던 어머니의 이름. 기억조차 버거웠던 제주의 아픈 비밀이 두 사람의 삶을 관통하는 찬란한 진실이 되어 피어난다.

*이 동영상은 배급사가 인증했으며 적법한 절차를 통해 콘텐츠 자원을 공식적으로 제공받았음을 알립니다.

en.description:
Ep.19 [K-STORY] Movie 《My Name》

Spring of 1998. Yeong-ok, an 18-year-old boy insecure about having what's been treased to be a girl's name, wins the support of Kyeong-tae, a transfer student from Seoul, and becomes class president. But, he ends up becoming a puppet and becomes part of violence in the classroom. Jeong-soon, a mother who single-handedly raises her son Yeong-ok, pieces together her repressed childhood memories with the help of a new doctor. As she roams all over Jeju wearing sunglasses, memories of the day she had buried for over 50 years begins to surface. The name she wanted to forget out of shame and the name she had to protect with her whole being. The painful secret of Jeju, which was too heavy even to recall, a brilliant truth that pierces through the lives of the two.

snippet.title: (MAY 12, 2026) 21ST CABINET MEETING
snippet.description:
(MAY 12, 2026) PRESIDENT LEE JAE MYUNG: THE 21ST CABINET MEETING & THE 8TH EMERGENCY ECONOMIC REVIEW MEETING

📌1:23 Opening Remarks by President Lee Jae Myung

[Emergency Government Response and Current Status Regarding the Middle East Conflict]
📌22:47 Ministry of Economy and Finance – Macroeconomy and Price Response Team
📌29:22 Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy – Energy Supply and Demand Team
📌34:44 Financial Services Commission – Financial Stability Team
📌39:09 Ministry of Health and Welfare – Livelihood and Welfare Team
📌43:07 Ministry of Foreign Affairs – Overseas Situation Management Team

[Ministry Reports]
📌48:22 Ministry of Education – Plan to Stabilize School Uniform Prices
📌51:22 Fair Trade Commission – Measures Against Bid Rigging in School Uniform Procurement
📌57:14 Ministry of Health and Welfare – Strengthening the Welfare Safety Net for Vulnerable Households
📌1:05:18 Personal Information Protection Commission – Transition Plan to a Prevention-Oriented Personal Data Management System

[2026 Summer Natural Disaster Countermeasures]
📌1:20:01 Ministry of the Interior and Safety – Summer Heavy Rain and Heatwave Measures
📌1:24:28 Ministry of Climate and Energy – Summer Flood Prevention Measures
📌1:27:10 Korea Meteorological Administration – Proactive Response to Summer Extreme Weather Through Reform of Warning Systems

[Request for Cooperation in Preparing the 2027 People-Centered Government Budget]
📌1:41:52 Ministry of Planning and Budget – Request for Cooperation in Preparing the 2027 People-Centered Government Budget

[Disappearance of an Elementary School Student in Juwangsan, Cheongsong, North Gyeongsang Province]

✔ **Child Still Missing for Three Days… All Available Resources Must Be Mobilized**
▪️Ensuring the child safely returns to the family is one of the government’s most important responsibilities

[Research Confirms Active and Strategic Fiscal Policy Provides Real Momentum for the Livelihood Economy]

✔ **Livelihood Recovery Coupons Proven Effective**
▪️Recovery coupons increased sales and consumption for local small businesses by approximately KRW 430,000 per KRW 1 million distributed
▪️KRW 1 million in fiscal spending generated a total economic effect of KRW 1.43 million
▪️Stimulating economic circulation through investment is the role of government
▪️Boosting domestic demand and GDP growth through active fiscal policy can lower the national debt ratio by expanding the economic base
▪️Enhancing potential growth, productivity, and tax revenue while reducing debt ratios over the long term can create a virtuous cycle of growth
▪️The government will focus its capabilities on laying the foundation for a major leap forward in the national economy through proactive fiscal policy

✔ **Middle East Conflict Enters 11th Week**
▪️Instability in oil prices and some consumer prices continues
▪️Exports are recording explosive growth
▪️Capital markets are showing historic growth trends
▪️The Korean people once again demonstrate resilience shown during the IMF crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic
▪️No clear end to the war is in sight, and post-war challenges are expected to continue
▪️The government will proactively respond to industrial and economic restructuring after the conflict while minimizing economic shocks
▪️Comprehensive measures for livelihood stability are being pursued

✔ **Improving People’s Lives Is the Responsibility of the State**
▪️Stabilizing livelihoods begins with normalizing accumulated irregularities in everyday life
▪️Unfair collusion, favoritism, and practices that profit at others’ expense must be completely rooted out
▪️Greater social trust will help build a foundation for national unity and stable growth
▪️Efforts to normalize issues such as excessive school uniform pricing, illegal valley facilities, maintenance problems, highway rest-stop cartels, and real estate collusion must accelerate
▪️Concerns were also raised regarding “Sangnoksu,” established to manage non-performing loans
▪️Financial institutions receiving government tax support are generating tens of trillions of won in profits
▪️President Lee ordered investigations into the private bad bank “Sangnoksu”

#PresidentLeeJaeMyung #CabinetMeeting #OpeningRemarks

🔹Date: May 12, 2026 (Tue) 10:00
🔹Venue: Main Building, Blue House

snippet.title: (MAY 11, 2026) BRIEFING BY THE MINISTER OF THE INTERIOR AND SAFETY
snippet.description:
(May 11, 2026) Minister of the Interior and Safety Yoon Ho-jung’s Briefing on the Second Round of High Oil Price Relief Payments

📌12:05 Q&A Session

[Announcement of the Second Round of High Oil Price Relief Payments]

✔ **Eligibility Criteria**
▪️The second round of relief payments will be provided to approximately 36 million citizens
▪️Recipients will be selected based on health insurance premium criteria
▪️Household characteristics such as dual-income families will be taken into account

✔ **Payment Amounts**
▪️Payments range from KRW 100,000 to KRW 250,000 per person
▪️Differential payments based on regional support principles
▪️KRW 100,000 for the Seoul metropolitan area and KRW 150,000 for non-metropolitan regions

✔ **Application Schedule and Method**
▪️Applications accepted from May 18 to July 3
▪️Funds may be used until August 31
▪️Use will be restricted after the expiration date

[Announcement of Eligible Recipients for the Second Round of High Oil Price Relief Payments]

✔ **Standards for Determining Eligibility**
▪️Households will be determined based on resident registration records
▪️Dependent spouses and children covered under health insurance will be included in the same household
▪️Citizens with combined property tax assessment values exceeding KRW 1.2 billion in 2025 will be excluded

🔎Full briefing:

#HighOilPrices #ReliefPayments #MinistryOfTheInteriorAndSafety

🔹Date: May 11, 2026 (Mon)
🔹Venue: Briefing Room, Main Building, Government Complex Seoul
🔹Speaker: Minister of the Interior and Safety Yoon Ho-jung

snippet.title: (MAY 8, 2026) THE 54TH PARENTS' DAY CEREMONY
snippet.description:
(May 8, 2026) The 54th Parents' Day Ceremony | Parents! With The Wings Of Your Love, We Have Blossomed As One.

📌0:40 National Ceremony
📌4:58 Screening of Parents’ Day Introduction Video
📌9:52 Opening Remarks
📌13:04 Presentation of Carnations
📌15:52 Awards Ceremony
📌20:20 Congratulatory Remarks by President Lee Jae Myung

[On the 54th Parents’ Day, We Extend Deep Respect and Gratitude to All Parents]

✔ **Parents Carry the Weight of the World for Their Children**
▪️Today’s Republic of Korea stands upon their quiet dedication and sacrifice
▪️Their wish to leave a better world for their children has been the foundation of the nation’s prosperity and growth
▪️Parents have long borne responsibilities that should be shared by the nation and the community
▪️The birth and care of every child should blossom into a complete joy

✔ **Ensuring a Happy and Secure Retirement for Parents**
▪️Parents should be able to enjoy a happy retirement free from worry
▪️The people-centered government is preparing institutional measures to guarantee healthy and active later years
▪️Practical support systems and policies will continue to expand
▪️The nation and community will move together toward a society where all citizens can live happily

✔ **A Day to Share Warmth and Gratitude**
▪️Parents’ Day is a time to express feelings that may have gone unspoken
▪️There are families suffering while longing for loved ones they can no longer meet
▪️Parents of fallen public servants who lost their lives protecting citizens are also with us today
▪️We solemnly remember the noble sacrifices of young people who fulfilled their duties in the most dangerous places
▪️Carnations were presented to bereaved families as a pledge to stand by them until the end
▪️May health and peace be with all parents across this land

#ParentsDay #CommemorationCeremony #CommemorativeAddress

🔹Date: May 8, 2026 (Fri) 11:00
🔹Venue: International Conference Hall, Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry

snippet.title: [SMARTBIZ ACCELERATORS] Producing soups with Hanwoo, GOSAM NONGHYUP (고삼농협)
snippet.description:
Producing soups with Hanwoo, or a premium, native Korean cattle breed, GOSAM NONGHYUP
Guk or Tang, which means traditional soups in Korea, is usually boiled for a long time. And it provides a deep and savory taste. GOSAM NONGHYUP has developed convenient and healthy soups that can satisfy consumers with hectic lives. Aside from Hanwoo Sagol Gomtang, or Korean Premium Beef Bone Soup and Hanwoo Dogani Tang, or Korean traditional beef soup with a milky-white soup and less fat, the firm has released Samgyetang, or Korean ginseng chicken soup and Chueotang, or Korean loach soup as new products. After the pre-processing of meat and the broth extraction stages, the basis of the soup products is completed. The concentration and emulsification stages are carried out to create a deeper taste and maintain the improved product quality. We explore GOSAM NONGHYUP, which has earned positive reviews in the market by using reliable ingredients and enhancing hygiene control.   

For more information: bhc93@hanmail.net


국내산 한우를 기반으로 국탕류를 전문으로 생산하는 고삼농협
오랜 시간 정성으로 끓여 깊은 맛을 자랑하는 한국의 국탕류. 고삼농협은 이런 국탕류를 간편식으로 재해석해 건강한 한 끼를 구성하는 기업이다. 기름기 없는 뽀얀 국물이 특징인 한우 곰탕과 도가니탕은 물론, 삼계탕, 추어탕 등 보양식까지 선보이며 제품의 영역을 넓혀가고 있다. 당사는 고기 전처리와 육수 추출을 거쳐 제품의 기본 맛을 완성하고, 농축과 유화 공정을 통해 국물의 깊은 맛을 살리며 품질의 균일성을 유지한다. 정직한 원료와 투명한 공정으로 신뢰받고 있는 고삼농협을 알아본다. 

기업에 관한 문의: bhc93@hanmail.net

snippet.title: [SMARTBIZ ACCELERATORS] Making innovative attempts to improve people’s skin health, BIOBEAUTECH
snippet.description:
Making innovative attempts to improve people’s skin health, BIOBEAUTECH
BIOBEAUTECH has developed cutting-edge technologies for the production of high-quality cosmetic items. The firm has  developed and produced over 300 ingredients for cosmetics including plant-based surfactants, biomaterials and functional drug delivery materials. The ampoule essence and silk mask products of the company have obtained popularity in Central and South America. All the products have been produced at a hygienice and reliable smart factory based on the global standards. We look into BIOBEAUTECH, which has developed scientific methods for skin health and played a leading role in the global beauty industry. 

For more information: main@biobeautech.com


끊임없는 혁신으로 피부의 본질을 탐구하는 바이오뷰텍
화장품 원료 개발 기술력을 바탕으로 완제품을 제조하는 바이오뷰텍. 당사는 다양한 식물 계면활성제, 바이오 관련 소재, 효능이 우수한 약물 전달제 등 300여 종 이상의 화장품 원료를 자체 개발하고 있다. 자체 개발된 원료 소재들을 적용한 앰플 에센스와 마스크팩은 중남미 시장에서 인기몰이 중이다. 이러한 제품은 안전하고 청결한 스마트팩토리를 통해 글로벌 기준에 맞게 생산된다. 피부를 과학적으로 연구하며 글로벌 뷰티 트렌드를 선도하는 바이오뷰텍을 만나본다. 

기업에 관한 문의: main@biobeautech.com

snippet.title: [SMARTBIZ ACCELERATORS] Providing total solutions for the mobility industry, MABA INDUSTRIAL
snippet.description:
Providing total solutions for the mobility industry, MABA INDUSTRIAL
MABA INDUSTRIAL has suggested overall solutions for automobiles including exterior designs, inner parts and displays. The company has built its own design institute which consists of more than 15 skilled designers specializing in transportation, visual designs, images as well as UI and UX designs for mobility. Based on the advanced capabilities, the company has developed future-oriented commercialization solutions for the mobility industry. The solutions can provide customized information and spaces according to different purposes. The company has fulfilled the needs of the clients with the precise plans and creative designs. We introduce MABA INDUSTRIAL, which has suggested new technologies and designs that can connect humans and offer a new experience. 

For more information : maba@maba.co.kr


모빌리티 분야의 토탈 솔루션을 제공하는 마바산업
자동차 분야의 외관 디자인 및 내부 구성품, 디스플레이 등 차량 전반의 솔루션을 공급하는 기업이다. 모빌리티 UI, UX에 특화된 디자이너들로 구성된 자체 디자인 연구소를 운영하며 독보적인 경쟁력을 갖추게 되었다. 최근에는 차량 외부 디자인 역량을 기반으로 사용자의 목적에 따라 차량 내부의 공간과 정보가 변화되는 미래형 모빌리티를 개발하는 데 힘쓰고 있다. 정확하게 설계된 디자인 데이터에 창의적인 아이디어를 결합해 완벽한 시공을 선보인다. 기술과 디자인을 연결하며 미래 모빌리티의 기준을 만들고 있는 마바산업을 취재한다. 

기업에 관한 문의: maba@maba.co.kr

snippet.title: (MAY 10, 2026) MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS BRIEFING
snippet.description:
(May 10, 2026) Ministry of Foreign Affairs Briefing on the Joint Government Investigation into the HMM Namu-ho Incident

📌4:11 Q&A Session

[Announcement of Investigation Results into the HMM Namu-ho Fire Incident in the Strait of Hormuz on May 4]

✔ **Government Dispatches Investigation Team to the Site**
▪️The government dispatched investigators from the Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal and fire inspection experts from the National Fire Agency
▪️The HMM Namu-ho docked at Dubai Port on the evening of May 7 (local time)
▪️The investigation team conducted detailed inspections of both the exterior and interior of the vessel
▪️The Consulate General of Korea in Dubai, local Korean Register officials, and military experts also participated in the investigation

[Findings Based on the On-Site Investigation]

✔ **Two unidentified aerial objects struck the HMM Namu-ho twice at approximately 15:30 on May 4**
▪️Flames and smoke accompanied by vibrations were observed after the impact
▪️Damage measuring approximately 5 meters wide and 7 meters deep was found on the port-side stern exterior
▪️The internal frame structure was bent inward
▪️Parts of the outer hull protruded and bent outward
▪️CCTV footage captured the aerial objects, though limitations remain in identifying the origin or type
▪️Additional analysis of recovered engine debris from the aerial objects is planned

✔ **Engine Room Fire Presumed to Have Ignited After the First Strike**
▪️The second strike rapidly intensified the fire
▪️The cause of the fire is believed unrelated to the vessel’s internal systems
▪️No abnormalities were found in the ship’s engines, generators, or boilers
▪️The ignition point was identified near a punctured section above the ballast water tank
▪️At the time of the incident, damage occurred approximately 1 to 1.5 meters above sea level
▪️The possibility of attack by a mine or torpedo is considered low due to the nature of the blast pressure
▪️Any additional findings will be disclosed as they are confirmed

🔹Venue: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Briefing Room, Government Complex Seoul

snippet.description:
Ep.19 [K-NOW] Seoul Forest in Full Bloom as K-Garden! 《2026 Seoul International Garden Show》

Running from May 1 to October 27,this year’s 2026 Seoul International Garden Showspans an unprecedented 180 days,the longest in its history.

Centered around Seoul Forest,the festival now extends across the city,transforming Seoul itselfinto one vast, living garden.

From imaginative gardens by designers around the worldto K-pop-inspired spaces and uniquely curated corporate gardens,the culture and landscape of Seoulare reimagined in entirely new ways.

Join international visitors on a guided garden tour,experience hands-on gardening classes,and discover a moment where nature and K-culture come together.
Meet Seoul at its freshest, right here and now!


Ep.19 [K-NOW] 서울의 숲, K-정원을 입다! 《2026 서울국제정원박람회》

5월 1일부터 10월 27일까지
무려 180일간 펼쳐지는 
역대 최장 기간의 《2026 서울국제정원박람회》!

올해는 서울숲을 중심으로 
서울 도심 곳곳으로 축제가 이어지며
도시 전체가 하나의 거대한 정원으로 확장됐다.

세계 각국 작가들의 개성 넘치는 정원부터
K팝과 만난 정원, 기업들의 감성을 담은 이색 정원까지
서울이라는 도시의 문화와 풍경이 새롭게 태어난다.

외국인 관광객들과 함께한 정원 투어,
식물과 함께 힐링하는 원예 클래스 등
자연과 K-컬처가 어우러진 
서울의 가장 싱그러운 순간을 지금 만나보자!

snippet.title: [VIBE IN ACTION K-INITIATIVE] Ep.5 Bio Designed by AI and Quantum (Han Nam-shik, Professor)
snippet.description:
Ep.5 Bio Designed by AI and Quantum (Han Nam-shik, Professor, Department of Quantum Information, Yonsei University & Head of AI Research, Milner Therapeutics Institute, University of Cambridge)

[Bio Designed by AI and Quantum]
AI is already deeply embedded across the bio industry, from diagnosis and treatment to drug development.
In this episode, we explore the changes AI is bringing and how quantum computing, a new technology, is expanding our understanding of complex life phenomena that were once difficult to solve.
An era where diseases can be predicted based on an individual’s genetic information, and even treated before they develop.
Discover the future of bio shaped by AI and quantum.

Ep.5 AI와 양자가 설계하는 바이오 (한남식, 연세대 양자정보학과 교수 & 케임브리지대 밀너 의약연구소 AI 연구센터장)

[AI와 양자가 설계하는 바이오]
AI는 이미 진단과 치료, 신약 개발까지 바이오 산업 전반에 깊숙이 들어와 있다.
이번 회차에서는 AI가 만들어내는 변화와, 기존에는 풀기 어려웠던 생명 현상의 복잡성을 ‘양자 컴퓨팅’이라는 새로운 기술로 어떻게 확장해 나가는지 살펴본다.
개인의 유전 정보를 기반으로 질병을 예측하고, 발병 이전 치료까지 가능한 시대.
AI와 양자가 만들어갈 ‘바이오’의 미래를 만나본다.

snippet.title: [K-CULTURE MINUTES: K-STAGE] Ep.17 Musical 《When I Close My Eyes》
snippet.description:
Ep.17 [K-STAGE] Musical 《When I Close My Eyes》

Carolina and Dominico are former neighbors who appear before an eccentric inventor living in the beautiful small Italian village of Manarola. 
It is a story about awkward neighbors who become friends that offer each other true love and support, based on the true story of Italian inventor Pellegrino Turri.


Ep.17 [K-STAGE] 뮤지컬 《너를위한글자》

아름다운 이탈리아 작은 마을 ‘마나롤라’에 사는 괴짜 발명가 앞에 나타난
과거 이웃 캐롤리나와 도미니코. 어색하고 불편했던 이웃이 서로 진정한 사랑과 응원을 건네는 친구가 되어가는 이야기로, 이탈리아 발명가 ‘펠리그리노 투리’의 실제 이야기를 모티브로 한 뮤지컬이다

snippet.title: Did you know Jeonbuk State is packed with diverse spots to explore?ㅣ K-Hotspots:#hiddengems.Ep.5
snippet.description:
Ready for a magical journey in Jeonbuk State? Join global travel creator Sesam Rana Magar, who serve Ready for a magical journey in Jeonbuk State? Join global travel creator Sesam Rana Magar, who serves as a Jinan Global Ambassador! Marvel at the mysterious stone pagodas of Maisan, stroll through the picturesque streets of Jeonju Hanok Village in a beautiful Hanbok, and feel the thrill of winter at Muju Deogyusan Resort! Discover the endless and diverse charms of Jeonbuk State in our fifth journey! 🏔️

📍 Spots Featured in the Video

1.Jinan Maisan
255, Maisannam-ro, Maryeong-myeon, Jinan-gun, Jeonbuk State, Republic of Korea

2.Jeonju Hanok Village 
99, Girin-daero, Wansan-gu, Jeonju-si, Jeonbuk State, Republic of Korea

3.Muju Deogyusan Ski Resort
185, Manseon-ro, Seolcheon-myeon, Muju-gun, Jeonbuk State, Republic of Korea

✨ Cast
Photos provided by 
Sesam Rana Magar

——————————————————————

신비로운 돌탑부터 한옥마을, 눈 덮인 스키장까지! 전북특별자치도에 이렇게 다채로운 명소들이 많다는 사실, 알고 계셨나요? ❄️ K-Hotspots:#hiddengems Ep.5 #전북특별자치도

전북특별자치도에서 펼쳐지는 마법 같은 여정, 준비되셨나요? 진안 글로벌 앰배서더로 활동 중인 글로벌 트래블 크리에이터 세삼 라나 마가르(Sesam Rana Magar)! 신비로운 돌탑이 절경을 이루는 마이산을 감상하고, 아름다운 전주 한옥마을의 거리를 한복을 입고 거닐어 본 뒤, 무주 덕유산 리조트 스키장에서 짜릿한 겨울을 만끽해 보세요! 끝없이 펼쳐지는 전북특별자치도의 다양한 매력을 그녀의 다섯 번째 여정에서 함께 발견해 보세요! 🏔️

📍 영상 속 장소

1. 진안 마이산
전북특별자치도 진안군 마령면 마이산남로 255

2. 전주 한옥마을
전북특별자치도 전주시 완산구 기린대로 99

3. 무주 덕유산리조트 스키장
전북특별자치도 무주군 설천면 만선로 185

✨ 출연진
사진 제공: 세삼 라나 마가르 (Sesam Rana Magar)

snippet.title: (MAY 7, 2026) THE 32ND PRESIDENTIAL SENIOR SECRETARIES' MEETING
snippet.description:
(MAY 7, 2026) THE 32ND PRESIDENTIAL SENIOR SECRETARIES' MEETING

📌1:25 Opening Remarks by President Lee Jae Myung

[First Round of High Oil Price Relief Payments to Be Completed Tomorrow]

✔ Please ensure thorough pre-inspection and public outreach ahead of the second round of payments beginning on the 18th

✔ *Continued instability in international oil prices is increasing inflationary pressure*
▪️Oil prices have risen 20% due to uncertainty surrounding ceasefire negotiations
▪️Consumer price growth in April expanded compared to March
▪️Continued inflation could place greater pressure on people’s livelihoods
▪️Weakening consumer sentiment may weigh heavily on the economic recovery
▪️Now is the time to fully mobilize efforts to manage supply chains for key raw materials and stabilize supply and demand for major goods
▪️How we overcome this crisis will determine the future of our economy

✔ *Public Participation National Growth Fund to Launch on the 20th*
▪️The world is currently engaged in a “war without gunfire” over leadership in future industries and the economy
▪️Active public investment and participation will provide new vitality and dynamism to Korean industries

✔ *Basic Act on Life and Safety Nearing Passage in the National Assembly*
▪️The legislation reflects the resolve that no citizen should lose their life due to the absence of the state
▪️The Blue House and government are asked to carefully prepare follow-up systems to ensure smooth implementation
▪️National capabilities must be united to build a safer country for everyone

#PresidentLeeJaeMyung #SeniorAdvisorsMeeting #OpeningRemarks

🔹Date: May 7, 2026 (Thu) 14:00
🔹Venue: Yeomin Hall, Blue House

snippet.description:
With a population of 65 million and a GDP growth rate of 6.4%, Tanzania is drawing attention as a key hub in East Africa. The country established diplomatic relations with S. Korea in 1992, and the Embassy of Tanzania in Seoul opened in 2018. Recent progress in bilateral ties has been driven in part by the participation of Korean companies in infrastructure reforms across Tanzania. KORAIL is overseeing Tanzania’s Central Line railway construction project, while the Tanzanite Bridge—an emerging landmark in Dar es Salaam, the country’s largest city—was built by South Korea’s GS Engineering & Construction. This episode explores the Korean expertise and collaborative effort embedded throughout Tanzania’s infrastructure.


인구 6500만명, GDP 성장률 6.4%, 동아프리카의 허브로 주목받는 나라, 탄자니아다. 한국과는 1992년 수교해 2018년 주한 탄자니아 대사관이 개설됐다. 비교적 최근에 양국 관계가 진전한 데에는 탄자니아의 인프라 개혁이 이뤄지는 곳곳에 한국 기업들이 참여한 덕분이기도 하다. 탄자니아 중앙선 철도 건설 사업에 코레일이 감리를 맡고 있으며, 최대 도시 다르에스살람의 떠오르는 명소인 탄자나이트 교량은 GS 건설이 공사했다. 탄자니아 인프라 곳곳에 숨겨진 한국의 땀과 기술을 알아본다.

snippet.title: [K-CULTURE MINUTES: K-STAGE] Ep.18 Musical 《Fly High, Taekwon》
snippet.description:
Ep.18 Musical 《Fly High, Taekwon》

Korea's first Taekwondo musical,《Fly High, Taekwon》, has received favorable reviews since its premiere in 2022, with an audience rating of 9.8. Top-tier Korean Taekwondo demonstration teams, led by Eom Ji-min, who won the Golden Buzzer on America's Got Talent and the captain of the World Taekwondo Federation Demonstration Team, and professional musical actors create a spectacular stage performance.

2022년 초연부터 관객평점 9.8을 기록하며 호평을 받아온 국내최초 태권도 뮤지컬 《태권, 날아올라》 . 아메리카 갓 탤런트에서 골든부저를 받은 주인공이자 세계태권도 연맹 시범주장인 엄지민등 국내 최정상급 태권도 시범단과 전문 뮤지컬 배우들이 화려한 무대를 연출한다.

snippet.title: (MAY 6, 2026) THE 20TH CABINET MEETING
snippet.description:
(May 6, 2026) President Lee Jae Myung’s 20th Cabinet Meeting & 7th Emergency Economic Review Meeting

📌1:22 Opening Remarks by President Lee Jae Myung

[Emergency Government Response and Current Status Regarding the Middle East Conflict]
📌27:24 Ministry of Economy and Finance – Macroeconomy and Price Response Team
📌32:07 Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy – Energy Supply and Demand Team
📌43:59 Financial Services Commission – Financial Stability Team
📌53:46 Ministry of Health and Welfare – Livelihood and Welfare Team
📌58:20 Ministry of Foreign Affairs – Overseas Situation Management Team

[Ministry Reports]
📌1:01:27 Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs – Comprehensive Farmland Survey Plan
📌1:28:49 Financial Services Commission – Progress Report on Inclusive Financial Transformation to Save Lives
📌1:54:52 Office for Government Policy Coordination – Suicide Prevention Measures and Future Plans
📌2:13:50 Ministry of Health and Welfare – Measures to Strengthen Response for High-Risk Suicide Groups

[Inter-Ministerial Cooperation Agenda]
📌2:37:21 Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission – Implementation Plan for Integration of Non-Emergency and Counseling Hotline 110

[Current Constitution Insufficient to Safeguard the Nation… Constitutional Amendment Vote Scheduled for Tomorrow]

✔ **Constitutional Amendment Proposal to Be Voted on Tomorrow**
▪️Partial constitutional revision deemed more realistic than a full revision
▪️Opportunity to include the spirit of the May 18 Democratic Uprising and the Buma Democratic Protests in the Constitution’s preamble
▪️Partial amendment also includes strengthening local autonomy and enhancing parliamentary oversight

✔ **Strict Response to the Three Major Election Crimes**
▪️Ensuring voters can make rational decisions is a core responsibility of the government
▪️Warning against fake news, vote-buying, and involvement of public officials
▪️Called for swift responses by police, prosecutors, and the National Election Commission

✔ **Criticism of Poor Bidding Practices at the Korea Forest Service**
▪️Pointed out years of repeated problems with improper bidding practices
▪️Administrative sanctions deemed ineffective; emphasized stronger financial penalties
▪️Called for improved internal communication and openness to external criticism within the public sector

✔ **Inquiry into Reinvestigation of Illegal Facility Operations**
▪️Described the issue as one affecting trust and authority in state governance
▪️Ordered inspections and punishment over suspicions of deliberate concealment
▪️More than 33,000 illegal facilities identified… possible investigation for dereliction of duty if necessary

✔ **Emphasis on “Normalizing the Abnormal”**
▪️Called for efforts to identify abnormal practices and establish countermeasures
▪️Emphasized listening to diverse voices and encouraging critical discussion
▪️Ordered comprehensive measures for handling public complaints and petitions

#PresidentLeeJaeMyung #CabinetMeeting #OpeningRemarks

🔹Date: May 6, 2026 (Wed) 10:00
🔹Venue: Main Building, Blue House

snippet.title: [The Art of Pairing] Ep.4 One Table, All Together
snippet.description:
Ep.4 One Table, All Together

In Andong, where time moves at its own quiet pace, Tradition lives on as part of everyday life. Here, Fabri begins another journey, guided by the flavors of the region and its time-honored spirits. At the market, he encounters ingredients that define Andong, and before long, his steps lead him to where a single drink holds generations of craft. At Menge Craft Distillery, he discovers Jinmaek Soju, a spirit known for its deep and intense character, and experiences the time and dedication behind it. Bold yet clean on the finish, it reveals an even sharper balance when paired with food. Inspired by Andong’s local ingredients and traditional liquor, Fabri prepares dakgalbi and grilled gan godeungeo, bringing fire, depth, and balance to one harmonious spread. How will he bring together the smokiness of the flame, the richness of the fish, and the bold identity of traditional soju into one perfect pairing? 
Now, join us, at a table where time and flavor come together.

Dakgalbi
① Prep the chicken thighs and marinate it with the sauce.
② Cut the vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
③ Stir-fry the chicken first over medium heat to release its juices.
④ Add the vegetables in order and stir-fry together.
⑤ inish with tteok.

Gan Godeungeo Gui & Sesame Oil Mayo Sauce
① Place the mackerel on a lined pan and grill skin-side first.
② Flip and cook briefly to finish.
③ Make the mayo with egg, lemon juice, soy sauce, and neutral oil.
④ Add sesame oil, garlic, lemon zest, and chili for extra depth.
⑤ Serve alongside the grilled mackerel.


Ep.4 어우러짐의 한 상

시간이 천천히 흐르는 도시, 안동.
전통이 일상처럼 이어지는 이곳에서 파브리는 지역의 맛과 술을 따라 또 한 번의 여정을 시작한다. 시장에서는 안동을 대표하는 식재료들을 만나고, 그 발걸음은 자연스럽게 한 잔의 술이 만들어지는 곳으로 향한다. 맹개술도에서 그는 깊고 강렬한 풍미를 지닌 진맥소주를 만나고, 그 안에 담긴 시간과 정성을 경험한다. 묵직하지만 깔끔하게 떨어지는 맛, 그리고 음식과 만났을 때 더욱 선명해지는 균형. 
파브리는 안동의 식재료와 전통주를 바탕으로 닭갈비와 간고등어 구이를 준비하며 한 상의 조화를 완성해 나간다. 과연 그는 불맛의 깊이와 생선의 담백함, 그리고 전통주의 개성을 어떻게 하나로 풀어낼까? 지금, 시간과 맛이 이어지는 한 상을 만나보자.

《닭갈비 레시피》
① 닭다리살을 손질해 양념에 버무리고 잠시 재운다.
② 채소를 먹기 좋게 손질한다.
③ 팬에 닭고기를 먼저 볶아 육즙을 낸다.
④ 채소를 순서대로 넣어 함께 볶는다.
⑤ 떡을 넣어 마무리한다.

간고등어 구이 & 참기름 마요네즈 소스
① 팬에 종이호일을 깔고 중불에서 고등어를 껍질부터 굽는다.
② 뒤집어 잠시 더 익혀 마무리한다.
③ 달걀, 레몬즙, 간장, 식용유로 마요네즈를 만든다.
④ 참기름, 마늘, 레몬 제스트, 고추를 더해 풍미를 살린다.
⑤ 구운 고등어와 함께 곁들여 완성한다.

snippet.description:
Ep.18 [K-STORY] Living Through the Same Season

27th JEONJU International Film Festival Special [Living Through the Same Season]
Se-hoon and Jeong-ie start a long-distance relationship despite their busy schedules.  They care for and love each other but their differing ways of expression do cause issues... And their relationship changes according to the passing seasons. As they spend winter, spring, summer and autumn together then face a new winter... How will they look back upon their time together?

*This video is approved by the distributor and the content provided via legitimate channels

바쁜 일상에 쫓기며 장거리 연애를 이어가고 있는 세훈과 정이. 서로 소중히 여기고 사랑하지만
표현방식이 달라 조금씩 어긋나기도 하는데.. 계절의 변화와 함께 흘러가는 연인의 관계

snippet.title: [SMARTBIZ ACCELERATORS] Expanding business as a maker of coffee-based products, KABITREE (가비트리)
snippet.description:
Expanding business as a maker of coffee-based products, KABITREE
In the midst of busy life, people can enjoy time to relax while drinking coffee. KABITREE has developed brewing methods for cold brew coffee as well as produced a variety of new items. By focusing on the development of roasting skills, the firm has produced cold brew extracts as well as coffee gummy. The company has joined the Korean and overseas exhibitions and events to strengthen competitive power. We explore KABITREE, which has cultivated new markets by bringing about innovative changes to the business.

snippet.title: [SMARTBIZ ACCELERATORS] Making traditional Korean liquor with Nuruk, Han’s Fermentation Lab
snippet.description:
Making traditional Korean liquor with Nuruk, Han’s Fermentation Lab
As the only master of Nuruk, or a traditional Korean fermentation starter, CEO Han Yeong-seok has mainly produced traditional liquor only with rice, water and Nuruk. Under the motto, “Great Nuruk creates great liquor,” the firm produced premium traditional liquor based on the fermentation method. Without artificial additives, it has carried out the fermentation and aging stages and created a clean and deep flavor. By keeping the traditional recipe, the firm has introduced a smart system to stabilize the product quality. We look into Han’s Fermentation Lab, which has strengthened its position as a leading provider of premium liquor in Korea. 

For more information: hanslab-kor@hanslab-kor.com


누룩만을 연구하면 전통주를 빚는 한영석의 발효연구소
한영석의 발효연구소는 대한민국 유일 누룩 명인인 한영석 대표가 그동안 쌓아온 기술로 전통주를 빚는 기업이다. ‘좋은 누룩이 좋은 술을 빚는다’라는 철학 아래 쌀, 물, 누룩만을 사용해 청명주를 만든다. 청명주는 첨가물을 넣지 않고 발효 과정에서 자연스럽게 형성된 알코올 그대로 숙성해 깊고 깨끗한 풍미를 느낄 수 있다. 전통 양조 방식을 그대로 유지하면서 발효와 숙성 공정에는 스마트 시스템을 도입해 품질의 안정화를 이뤘다. 이러한 노력으로 청명주의 인지도를 높여가며 전통주 기업으로 자리매김하고 있는 한영석의 발효연구소를 알아본다. 

기업에 관한 문의: hanslab-kor@hanslab-kor.com

snippet.title: [SMARTBIZ ACCELERATORS] Producing Jeongbyeong as a two-generation family business, Edae Myeonggwa
snippet.description:
Producing Jeongbyeong snacks as a two-generation family business, Edae Myeonggwa
As a two-generation family business, Edae Myeonggwa has mainly produced traditional Korean crackers for over 70 years. The company produces Jeonbyeong, traditional Korean crispy and thin wheat crackers by using direct fire. Each cracker has a thin and crispy texture as well as a nutty taste. The firm has maintained the flavors of the original ingredients including nuts and dried seaweed. By joining the smart factory project of Samsung Electronics, it has introduced MES and increased the production efficiency. We introduce Edae Myeonggwa, which has constantly expanded the business by entering the major department stores in Korea.

For more information : 2dae@daum.net


2대에 걸쳐 전병 과자를 만들고 있는 이대명과
70년의 세월 동안 2대에 걸쳐 전통 과자를 만들어 온 기업이다. 당사는 한국의 전통 과자인 전병을 불에 굽는 옛날 방식 그대로 제조한다. 이런 방식으로 얇고 바삭하면서 고소한 식감을 살리고, 견과류나 김, 파래 등 다양한 재료를 넣어 특색을 더했다. 이번 삼성 스마트팩토리 지원사업으로 MES 시스템을 도입해 모든 공정을 데이터화하며 생산의 효율까지 높였다. 국내 백화점을 중심으로 브랜드를 확장하며 전통 전병의 프리미엄화를 꾀하는 이대명과를 만나본다. 

기업에 관한 문의: 2dae@daum.net

snippet.description:
Producing special vehicles based on the advanced skills, TAEKWANG
Special vehicles have played a significant role in different parts of the society. TAEKWANG has produced premium special vehicles based on the accumulated production skills. The company has mainly produced wreckers which are used for accident recovery. By introducing a smart factory, the firm has increased the product quality and stability. We explore TAEKWANG, which has contributed to strengthening safety in different industries by developing advanced technologies.

풍부한 제조 기술을 바탕으로 우수한 품질의 특장차를 생산하는 기업, 태광

월경용품은 여성의 일상 속, 가장 가까이에서 사용된다. 실제 사용자들의 목소리가 제품 개발에 반영돼 일상 속 불편을 해결하는데 집중하는 기업이 있다. ‘우리가 추구하는 가치를 생산한다’ 라는 철학을 가지고 유기농 순면 생리대부터 시작해서 탐폰까지 직접 프리미엄 브랜드들을 제작하고 있다. 여성의 건강이라는 것을 최우선 가치로 두고 안전하고 편리하게 사용할 수 있는 월경 용품을 생산하는 것이다. 여성헬스케어 전문기업 볼디는 몸에 직접 닿는 제품인 만큼 안전성과 편안한 사용감을 최우선한다. 그 가치를 제품으로 실현하는 기업, 볼디를 만나본다.

snippet.title: [SMARTBIZ ACCELERATORS] Keeping the tradition of Korean kimchi, kimjangdok (김장독)
snippet.description:
Keeping the tradition of Korean kimchi, kimjangdok
Kimchi is a traditional Korean side dish and it can be made with different ingredients. By using napa cabbages with a natural sweet taste, kimjangdok has developed kimchi with reduced saltiness and an improved flavor of red pepper powder. The low-salt soaking process is carried out for 24 hours. And the firm has focused effort into keeping the optimal salinity level. The company has mainly produced Jeollanam-do-style kimchi which has a spicy, but a deep and savory taste. Napa cabbage kimchi, young radish kimchi and green onion kimchi are the main products. And all the products are made with low-sodium salted seafood. The napa cabbages go through the soaking process for a longer period of time. Also, the mixed seasoning is spread between every leaf of the cabbage. We explore kimjangdok, which has put top priority on improving the systematic production system. 

For more information: msh3777@hanmail.net


김장독에서 천천히 익어가던 김치의 맛을 재현하는 김장독

snippet.title: [SMARTBIZ ACCELERATORS] Developing advanced adhesion technologies for industrial tapes, SAMBOO ATC
snippet.description:
Developing advanced adhesion technologies for industrial tapes, SAMBOO ATC
There is a company which has provided precision technologies that are considered necessary for people’s daily life and different industries. SAMBOO ATC has achieved growth by developing industrial tapes based on the high-level technical skills. The company has produced and processed various types of industrial tapes for the fields of shipbuilding, automobiles, electronics and construction. Aside from the tapes for box packing, it has produced variety of items including paper masking tapes and cloth tapes. The packing tapes can be used for precise works with the automatic slitting machines. As it is not easily cut while using it, the efficiency can be maximized. Thorough quality control is the core part of the entire manufacturing system. Based on its own technologies, uniform quality can be maintained and the adhesive power can be improved. We look into SAMBOO ATC, which has gained recognition both at home and abroad by constantly developing cutting-edge technologies. 

For more information: sambooatc@tape4masking.com


점착 기술력을 연구하며 국내 최고의 산업용 테이프를 제공하는 삼부ATC
우리 일상과 산업에서 작지만 결정적인 기술력을 제공하는 기업이 있다. 삼부ATC는 정밀함이 요구되는 산업용 테이프를 생산하며 성장해 온 기업이다. 당사는 조선, 자동차, 전자 및 건축용으로 쓰이는 다양한 산업용 테이프를 제조, 가공한다. 주요 제품으로는 상자 포장용 테이프, 종이 마스킹, 면 테이프 등이 있으며 특히 포장용 테이프는 자동화 기기로 정밀하게 작업되어 사용 시 끊어짐 없는 연속성을 보장한다. 고품질의 제품은 철저한 품질관리에서 비롯되며 독보적인 기술력을 통해 균일한 치수와 강력한 점착력이 구현된다. 기본에 충실한 기술력으로 국내외 시장에서 인정받고 있는 삼부ATC를 취재한다. 

기업에 관한 문의: sambooatc@tape4masking.com
